acquisition_records.measurement: Conservative reserve after initial host counter failure

measurement_boundary: Selected source/account/authority output exposed to the author is counted. The first batch uses a conservative 32 KiB reserve because a host TextEncoder counter was unavailable after output; subsequent selected outputs use UTF-8 byte counts. Full local parser and hash reads of source/account blobs are excluded from the selected-context measure and are not claimed as bounded I/O. Authored scripts and author-return metadata are not additional external source acquisition.
source_effect: One insertion in DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md §11A; every other source byte preserved.
